name: Platinic-Spire
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Whoever abandoned the buried megastructure did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
